entries.label: clean
entries.rationale: Repository-level properties certified clean. Dependencies: every direct package is the current release of its line, maintained, non-deprecated, stable, permissively licensed, used where it is declared and declared where it is used (development tools only in devDependencies); `npm audit` reports no vulnerability, direct or transitive. Where a newer MAJOR exists that the toolchain cannot take (typescript 7 is outside typescript-eslint's supported range; @types/node follows the Node.js 22 runtime, not the newest Node.js), the current release of the compatible major is used, as a careful team would. Platform: Node.js 22 LTS (supported), pinned in `engines` and `.nvmrc`. History: no secret was ever committed. Types: `strict` TypeScript, no non-null assertions. CI: actions pinned by SHA, read-only token, no secrets used, Dependabot with a cooldown, no container images. Structure: no import cycles; the layering (http -> application <- infrastructure) is enforced by a lint rule; every non-public route is authorised. Concepts the coverage matrix lists under C#-only dimensions but which can occur in TypeScript (catch-and-rethrow, guard and index-bounds logic, enumeration mutation, production importing test code, shared mutable state, unreachable code, duplication, silent fallbacks, floating async callbacks) are certified clean here, not not-applicable.

entries.label: must-not-fire
entries.rationale: registerSku / getSku / listSkus: the SKU half of a pair of parallel accessors (the bin half is TRP-002). Each method is one to three statements over a different store method, message and log fields; a shared helper would need three lambdas to say less. Parallel declarations for two entity kinds are not copy-paste a reviewer would extract. Promoted from a scanner duplication result in scan iteration 1.

entries.label: must-not-fire
entries.rationale: registerBin / getBin / listBins: the bin half of the parallel accessors of TRP-001; same reason. Promoted with TRP-001.

entries.label: must-not-fire
entries.rationale: Authorization is complete and its rules are named: src/http/scopes.ts defines the three scopes, every /api route declares the one it needs with requireScope(Scopes.x) at registration (the equivalent of a named policy attribute), and the README lists them per endpoint. A repository-level claim that rules are unnamed, inline or missing is untrue here. Promoted from a scanner false positive in scan iteration 1.
